facts.fact: Africa Data Centres (Cassava Technologies) operates the JHB1 data centre in Johannesburg, designated a Microsoft Azure ExpressRoute Metro peering location, with Liquid C2 selling Secure CloudConnect to organisations from it; the article gives no opening date, so as_of is its publication date of 2026-07-20.

note: ExpressRoute Metro is a cloud on-ramp, not a cloud region; no cloud fact.
